bots.zh: OpenAI 训练爬虫。拦它不等于拦用户让 ChatGPT 打开网页。
bots.en: OpenAI training crawler. Blocking it does not block user-initiated ChatGPT browsing.

bots.zh: 用户在 ChatGPT 里点开网页时的抓取。不是训练爬虫。
bots.en: User-initiated fetch when ChatGPT opens a page. Not the training crawler.

bots.zh: ChatGPT 搜索索引爬虫。拦它会影响 ChatGPT 搜索收录，不是 GPTBot。
bots.en: ChatGPT search indexer. Blocking it affects ChatGPT search, not GPTBot training.

bots.zh: Gemini / Vertex AI 训练与产品用。不挡 Googlebot 搜索收录。
bots.en: Gemini / Vertex AI training and products. Does not block Googlebot search.

bots.zh: Anthropic 旧训练 token，建议与 ClaudeBot 一并处理。
bots.en: Legacy Anthropic training token. Treat alongside ClaudeBot.

bots.zh: 用户在 Claude 里点开网页时的抓取。不是训练爬虫。
bots.en: User-initiated fetch when Claude opens a page. Not the training crawler.

bots.zh: Claude 搜索索引爬虫。拦它会影响 Claude 搜索收录。
bots.en: Claude search indexer. Blocking it affects Claude search.

bots.zh: 字节跳动爬虫，常用于训练与产品抓取。
bots.en: ByteDance crawler, often used for training and product fetches.

bots.zh: Common Crawl 公共语料爬虫，很多模型会用这份数据。
bots.en: Common Crawl corpus crawler. Many models train on this data.

bots.zh: Perplexity 爬虫（索引 / 产品）。用户点开另见 Perplexity-User。
bots.en: Perplexity crawler (index / product). User-initiated fetches use Perplexity-User.

bots.zh: Apple Intelligence 训练与产品用。不挡 Applebot 搜索。
bots.en: Apple Intelligence training and products. Does not block Applebot search.

bots.zh: Amazon 全站爬虫，用于搜索与 Alexa 等产品。
bots.en: Amazon site crawler for search and Alexa-class products.

bots.zh: Meta 分享预览爬虫。拦它可能让 Facebook / Instagram 卡片失效；训练另见 meta-externalagent。
bots.en: Meta sharing-preview crawler. Blocking it can break Facebook / Instagram cards. Training uses meta-externalagent.

bots.zh: Meta AI 训练爬虫。不挡 Facebook 分享预览（那是 FacebookBot）。
bots.en: Meta AI training crawler. Does not block Facebook sharing previews (that is FacebookBot).
